title: 1st ICoN-Asia Forum
description: Hosted at City University of Hong Kong and chaired by Prof. Penny Han, the forum brings together researchers in nitrification and related nitrogen-cycle processes.

title: NSFC Symposium on Marine Ecosystem Changes and Tipping Processes
description: Penny will give a talk at 海洋生态系统演变与临界过程学术研讨会, held at City University of Hong Kong. Jointly organized by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, the Beijing–Hong Kong Academic Exchange Centre, and CityUHK’s State Key Laboratory of Marine Environmental Health.

title: CityUHK Green Week: Climate Change & Antarctic Research
description: Public seminar at City University of Hong Kong. Penny joined the fireside chat as a panelist.

title: Building sustainable cities in the face of climate emergency
description: Penny represented CityUHK at the Global Sustainable Development Congress in Jakarta, joining a panel on extreme weather and urban resilience. Read the related SEE feature in Times Higher Education.
